About

I'm Jason Duffett. By day I work on infrastructure — networks, certificates, the boring plumbing that keeps software reachable. By evening I play the ukulele, badly but happily.

This site is where the two halves meet. The tech posts are working notes from problems I've actually solved; the music posts are arrangements and recordings I want to keep somewhere other than a hard drive.

Written in Markdown, rendered by Eleventy, deployed to AWS CloudFront by composureCDK.

No cookies, no analytics, no tracking. If you want to hear about new posts, the RSS feed is the right door.
